purpose: Route day-to-day brand tasks to the smallest useful context pack.
operating_principle: The user should not choose Brand OS pages. The agent classifies the request, loads the compact core, adds only matching Section C/D slices, generates, then runs review gates.

context_budget.ask_clarifying_question_only_if: The output channel or audience materially changes the answer and cannot be inferred from the request.

conditional_load: strategy.edges filtered by matched channel source_anchors
channel_rules.channels matched by requested distribution surface
personal_branding when the request touches founder role, leadership presence, bio/about copy, portraits, speaker profile, or Founder Spectrum
3-5 most relevant training_examples from matched application pages
never_load_by_default: stale generated HTML as source of truth
personal-branding material unless the request explicitly belongs to that section
route_order: match composed route when a campaign/task pattern is explicit
match personal-branding route when the request concerns founder or leadership presence
match medium route from requested artifact type
match channel route from distribution surface
merge context loads and remove duplicates
run review gates before presenting output
review_gates: strategy fit: output serves the matched Focus Star anchors
voice fit: output follows identity voice and channel voice dial
medium fit: output follows visual_recipe, copy_recipe, and ai_rules
rules-out check: remove anything forbidden by matched channel rules_out
proof check: claims use approved proof only or are marked for human review
founder-role check: use the selected Founder Spectrum position before writing any personal-branding guidance
source hierarchy check: do not let the generated output rewrite Section A or B
